title: Instance-Level Difficulty: A Missing Perspective in Machine Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2410.03043v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current research on deep machine unlearning primarily focuses on improving or evaluating the overall effectiveness of unlearning methods while overlooking the varying difficulty of unlearning individual training samples. As a result, the broader feasibility of machine unlearning remains under-explored. This paper studies the cruxes that make machine unlearning difficult through a thorough instance-level unlearning performance analysis over various unlearning algorithms and datasets. In particular, we summarize four factors that make unlearning a data point difficult, and we empirically show that these factors are independent of a specific unlearning algorithm but only relevant to the target model and its training data. Given these findings, we argue that machine unlearning research should pay attention to the instance-level difficulty of unlearning.

translated_title: 实例级难度：机器遗忘中被忽视的视角
translated_abstract: 当前关于深度机器遗忘的研究主要集中于提升或评估遗忘方法的整体有效性，而忽视了遗忘单个训练样本时难度的差异。因此，机器遗忘更广泛的可行性仍然未被充分探索。本文通过对多种遗忘算法和数据集进行彻底的实例级遗忘性能分析，研究了使机器遗忘变得困难的关键因素。特别地，我们总结了导致遗忘某个数据点困难的四个因素，并通过实验表明这些因素与特定的遗忘算法无关，而仅与目标模型及其训练数据相关。基于这些发现，我们认为机器遗忘研究应当关注实例级的遗忘难度。
tldr: 本文从实例级角度研究机器遗忘的难度问题，总结出使遗忘某个数据点困难的四个因素，并证明这些因素仅取决于目标模型及其训练数据，而与具体的遗忘算法无关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the missing perspective of instance-level difficulty in machine unlearning, identifying four factors that make unlearning a data point difficult, which depend only on the target model and its training data rather than the specific unlearning algorithm.
